t0032-01.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
t0032-01.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

t0032-02.gloss: A grounds test and a locked gate leave a delivery outside its expected handoff.
t0032-02.rival_reading: Emergency crews could have restricted access and returned sealed containers; the note does not say what was inside.
